metrics: The three original raw figures and indices are copied from the owner's workbook. GDP per capita and its index are calculated offline from the supplied raw GDP/population using model V1. All values are stored at full precision in CSV; missing values and numeric zero remain distinct.
comparisons: Original metric medians are copied from Medians 197. GDP-per-capita raw/index medians are calculated offline over the 197-country reference set, excluding missing data. Median regions follow the workbook's UN M49 grouping; existing travel categories are unchanged.
citySelection: Editorially reviewed city and town highlights, starting from GeoNames populated-place names. Neighbourhoods and duplicate boroughs have been removed. These are destination highlights, not a uniform city-proper or metropolitan population ranking. Single-city states and Tuvalu list their main urban centre once.

unesco.label: UNESCO World Heritage Centre
unesco.note: 2014 property names used as editorial highlights; this is not a current inventory of inscribed sites.

editorial.label: Editorial highlights · destination guides
editorial.note: Reviewed city/town and attraction highlights, not visitor-count or population rankings. Small island countries can list settlements. Svalbard facts refer to the archipelago, not the joint Svalbard and Jan Mayen statistical unit.

profileExclusions.SJ: Owner requested Svalbard remain untouched. The workbook row combines Svalbard and Jan Mayen, so its figures are retained only in the source CSV, not applied to the Svalbard profile.

methodReference.status: Model V1 is implemented offline for GDP per capita, as subsequently requested by the owner. The three original workbook metrics and their cached indices/medians remain unchanged. No index calculations run in the application.

gdpPerCapita.preparation: Calculated offline from the supplied workbook's raw values. Competition ranks and maxima are separate for countries and territories. No rounding before indexing or aggregation. Zero or missing population yields N/A; missing GDP yields N/A.
gdpPerCapita.medians: World and continental medians use only the 197-country pool and available values. Raw and index medians are calculated separately; continental index medians use the globally computed country indices, not re-ranked continental indices.

comparisonOverrides.TR: Owner requested European median comparisons. Original workbook figures, continent classifications and baseline pools are preserved; the override selects European raw/index medians for all four metrics.
